steps.instruction:
Write file skeleton. Imports: logging, importlib, engine.base. Class PersonDeepDiveSkill with name='person_deep_dive', triggers=['tell me about person', 'deep dive', 'everything about', 'who is', 'profile for', 'full profile', 'person deep dive']. Define SUB_SKILLS:

SUB_SKILLS = {
    'person': ('data.people_lookup', 'PeopleLookupSkill'),
    'chart': ('data.query_natal_chart', 'QueryNatalChartSkill'),
    'events': ('data.search_life_events', 'SearchLifeEventsSkill'),
    'memos': ('data.search_voice_memos', 'SearchVoiceMemoSkill'),
}

Methods: execute, _run_skill, _build_profile. All 'pass'. ASCII only.

Implement _run_skill (importlib, getattr, await run, try/except). Implement _build_profile: collect summaries from ok responses in order [person, chart, events, memos]. Label each section: 'Person: ...', 'Natal Chart: ...', 'Life Events: ...', 'Voice Memos: ...'. Join with newline. Default: 'No profile data found.' Return string.

Implement execute(). Run all four sub-skills. Build profile. Merge data. Return SkillResponse(skill_name=self.name, data=merged, summary=profile, confidence=0.9, sources=['person_deep_dive']). try/except.
